scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test src/tests/registry.test.ts src/tests/engine.test.ts src/tests/mechanics_rules.test.ts src/tests/enchantment_physical.test.ts src/tests/book_mechanics.test.ts
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build:standalone
